messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SLO p95 latency > threshold in eu-west. metric=inference.latency.p95 value=1.62s threshold=1.2s p99=3.18s traffic_multiplier=2.1
PagerDuty Bot: Incident #INC12345 pager sent to rotation (primary oncall: Maria (oncall))
Maria (oncall): ack @PagerDuty Bot. I'm on it, checking recent deploys and autoscale.
Ajay: grabbing logs from router + sidecars, noticed 50% increase in queue length on sidecar-2
Leo: kvcache.evictions spike in eu-west around 1763131250, maybe hotkey? logs: `kvcache.evictions=1200/min`
Maria (oncall): no deploys in last 15m per deploy bot. running quick `redwood infra status --region eu-west`
Maria (oncall): outputs: `pool eu-west running 6 replicas, avg_lat=900ms, queue=420` — queue high.
Ajay: can we scale pool up? `redwood infra scale --pool eu-west --delta +2` I'll watch.
Maria (oncall): scaling now.
PagerDuty Bot: Maria (oncall) acknowledged at 1763131320
Leo: also seeing GPU mem high on a subset (pod inference-3), OOM? `dmesg` shows throttling.
Ajay: reducing batching: set batch_max_tokens 4096->2048 on the router config to lower tail latency.
Maria (oncall): applying batch config change `kubectl apply -f router-config.yaml` — done.
Maria (oncall): also enabling fallback routing to model-lite for low-latency routes: `routes: /v1/generate -> model: mix-lite` (temporary)
Sarah: tagging CS and support: "CS: we see a small percentage of customers experiencing slow responses, tipping into retries."
Maria (oncall): quick customer impact estimate: 3.8% of requests in eu-west saw >1.5s latency, error rate stable.
Leo: kvcache warming started; evictions falling after config change.
Ajay: after scale and batch change, p95 dropped to 1.15s, p99 2.1s (metrics @1763131370)
Maria (oncall): nice. keeping the fallback in place for 10m, monitoring.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident status: acknowledged -> mitigation_in_progress
Maria (oncall): will continue monitoring for 30m then handoff.
Sarah: I'll take follow-up if it persists; ETA to be on-call at 1763132400. leaving a note for next shift.
Maria (oncall): handing off: summary: sudden traffic spike + kvcache hotkey + sidecar queue => scaled pool + reduced batching + fallback model; p95 back under SLO. logs and metrics attached in thread.
Leo: recommend postmortem to look at cache hotspotting and autoscale thresholds.
Maria (oncall): agreed. assigning follow-up to Ajay + Leo.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC12345 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring. Will auto-resolve if no further alerts in 30m.
Maria (oncall): resolving my active ack, leaving to Sarah for watch. :white_check_mark:
